title: How many ten thousand tokens make twelve thousand?
description: Meera has twelve thousand tokens at her school mela in Pune. The video swaps ten of them for one bigger token and reads the chart.
teaching_notes: One idea: ten thousand tokens swap for one token in the TTh column. Watch for the child who keeps all twelve in the thousands column.

source: Make 12,000 from thousand tokens and say how many TTh and Th
video_script.why: The child has met the TTh column but has not yet made a number that needs both TTh and Th.
video_script.substitution: Swap ten thousand tokens for one bigger token, then read what is left in each column.
video_script.anchor: Meera's tray of thousand tokens at her school mela in Pune
video_script.wrong_answer: twelve tokens in the thousands column
video_script.wrong_move: Chintu keeps all twelve tokens in the Thousands column. Ten tokens of one place must swap for one token in the next column.
video_script.payoff_line: twelve thousand is one T T H token and two thousand tokens

final_answer.value: 1 TTh token and 2 Th tokens, the number 12,000
final_answer.spoken: one token in the T T H column and two in the thousands column

never_show: the your-turn answer 1 TTh token and 5 Th tokens
maths_rules: swap rule: 10 tokens of one place = 1 token of the next place on the left
10 thousand tokens regroup into 1 TTh token; 12 − 10 = 2 thousand tokens remain
chart: TTh 1, Th 2, H 0, T 0, O 0; the number is 12,000
slip: all 12 tokens left in the Th column
your turn: 15 thousand tokens; 10 regroup into 1 TTh token and 5 remain; 15,000; never shown
video_script.design: One idea: ten tokens swap for one token in the next column. Wrong idea: twelve tokens left in the Thousands column. The token tray stays as the anchor; the chart builds on the stage.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a tray of twelve thousand tokens in a row at a school mela; an empty place value chart with columns TTh, Th, H, T and O

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears
marks.tokens: twelve thousand tokens are laid in a row
marks.ask: an empty chart appears beside the tray

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='mela'/>Meera runs a stall at her school mela in Pune.
<bookmark mark='tokens'/>She has twelve tokens, and each token is worth one thousand.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How many tokens go in the T T H column, and how many in the thousands column?

beats.on_screen: the anchor holds still and gets an accent underline

marks.stop: the anchor is underlined in the accent colour

narration: <bookmark mark='stop'/>Stop the video. Say your answer out loud.

beats.on_screen: ten ones tokens swap for one tens token, then ten tens tokens swap for one hundreds token, shown as two quick swaps

marks.ones: ten ones tokens swap for one tens token
marks.tens: ten tens tokens swap for one hundreds token

narration: <bookmark mark='ones'/>Ten ones tokens swap for one tens token.
<bookmark mark='tens'/>Ten tens tokens swap for one hundreds token.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Whenever a column fills with ten tokens, they swap for one token in the next column.

beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows all twelve tokens sitting in the Th column; a full column flashes; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.chintu: Chintu's bubble appears with twelve tokens in the Th column
marks.full: the Th column flashes at ten tokens
marks.strike: the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twelve tokens in the thousands column. That is all of them.
<bookmark mark='full'/>A column that gets ten tokens is full, and it cannot hold any more.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ten tokens must move over to the next column on the left.

beats.on_screen: ten of the twelve thousand tokens swap for one token that lands in the TTh column; two tokens stay in Th

marks.swap: they swap for one token that lands in the TTh column
marks.left: two tokens stay in the Th column

narration: <bookmark mark='ten'/>Take ten of the twelve thousand tokens from the tray.
<bookmark mark='swap'/>They swap for one token in the T T H column.
<bookmark mark='left'/>Twelve take away ten leaves two thousand tokens, and those two tokens stay where they are.

beats.on_screen: the chart reads TTh 1, Th 2, H 0, T 0, O 0; the answer card reads 12,000

marks.chart: the chart fills in with 1 and 2 and zeros
marks.pay: the number 12,000 and the answer card appear
marks.write: the comma lands after the thousands place

narration: <bookmark mark='chart'/>Read the chart. One in the T T H column, two in the thousands column, and zeros after.
<bookmark mark='pay'/>Twelve thousand is one T T H token and two thousand tokens.
<bookmark mark='write'/>We write it with a comma placed after the thousands place.

<bookmark mark='two'/>Then read each column of the chart.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Make fifteen thousand from thousand tokens. How many tokens go in each column?
